hooks.command:
f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$f" in */../*) exit 0 ;; "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/frontend/src/*) ;; *) exit 0 ;; esac; p="$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/frontend/node_modules/.bin/prettier"; [ -x "$p" ] || { printf 'Prettier no encontrado en %s (ejecuta npm install en frontend/)
' "$p" >&2; exit 2; }; out=$("$p" --write --ignore-unknown "$f" 2>&1) || { printf 'Prettier falló al formatear %s:
%s
' "$f" "$out" >&2; exit 2; }
